General partition functions provide formal coverage but not the evaluated parity and entropy statement.

originality.rationale: The one-hub three-color wheel theorem has the same 2J and nJ crossings but neither contains two nonadjacent apices nor an odd-only H=J crossing; its Lucas count does not determine the 4-color bipyramid entropy-selected I(C_n,2) count. The 2009/2010 weighted proper-coloring papers take an infinite antiferromagnetic-coupling restriction and the 2010 p-wheel has adjacent apices. The 2011 paper studies periodic-lattice bulk behavior rather than this finite-field diagram. Strong historical-priority caveat remains.

value.rationale: The natural even Eulerian bipyramid and odd degree-defect counterparts exhibit a sharp parity-only field-J plateau; exact all-length occupation and degeneracy classification; a nontrivial critical weighted-independent-set entropy log2 and 2/3 occupation between adjacent 1/2 and 1 macrostates; and clear finite-size saturation scale. These are structural predictions beyond a single parameter table, not generic renaming or a known-wheel corollary.
